title: Deer holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#C8873A'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#E8B96A'/>

  <rect x='36' y='78' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#A06828'/>
  <rect x='58' y='78' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#A06828'/>

  <rect x='35' y='92' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#5A3410'/>
  <rect x='57' y='92' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#5A3410'/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <rect x='44' y='48' width='12' height='14' rx='5' fill='#C8873A'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='14' ry='13' fill='#D49A4A'/>

  <path d='M58 28 Q62 18 68 14' stroke='#B87830' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 18 Q66 16 70 18' stroke='#B87830' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='40' r='3' fill='#3A1E08'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='40' r='3' fill='#3A1E08'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='39' r='1' fill='#FFF5E0'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='39' r='1' fill='#FFF5E0'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#5A3410'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M46 50 Q50 53 54 50' stroke='#5A3410' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Arms holding heart -->
  <path d='M36 62 Q30 58 32 52' stroke='#C8873A' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 62 Q70 58 68 52' stroke='#C8873A' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Heart -->
  <path d='M50 56 C50 56 38 48 38 40 C38 34 44 32 48 36 C49 37 50 39 50 39 C50 39 51 37 52 36 C56 32 62 34 62 40 C62 48 50 56 50 56 Z' fill='#FF3B5C'/>
  <!-- Heart shine -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='40' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#FF8FA3' transform='rotate(-30 45 40)'/>
</svg>
